text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, Hishi 
Miracle and the others invited me to join 
an activity.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right~. We'll take a 
walk around the academy and look for 
'tiny, soothing' things.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It warms you up and heals your soul. I'm 
really looking forward to today, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've been working so hard 
lately. How about this to blow off some 
steam~?

Since my major tasks were cleared up, I 
gladly decided to join in on the two's 
activities. Or so I thought—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well~ let's start from the school gates. 
Hope we find something good~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, look at this! My chopsticks snapped 
completely perfectly~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Isn't this totally that thing!? You 
know, the divine blessing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Heeey. Trainer-san~?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Fufu, look at that bench over there. 
Three sparrows are huddling together like 
dumplings.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right~. That little sparrow 
ball is so cute~. Small animals really 
score high on the soothing scale, don't 
they?
—...This is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Mistake――Not soy milk, I wanted... to 
buy... water――"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe…… did not want this 
H2O――"water"…… I wanted to "purchase" "soy 
milk."

text_block_list.name: Kris S & Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――It's a miracle. ...A "Big Bang".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! A tiny sprout popped up. Twin 
leaves are just so soothing, aren't they?
choice_data_list: I think I kind of understand.

text_block_list.text: (Ding dong dang dong)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Shall we take a breather soon? How about 
some tea in the cafeteria?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I agree~. I'm getting a little 
peckish, maybe I should grab a bite to 
eat~?
choice_data_list: (That really was a nice change of pace—)

text_block_list.text: —Ah, that's...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, I knew it!!! My merch that I cried 
for three days and three nights thinking I 
lost it! So that's where you've been 
hiding!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"This is all thanks to their divine 
protection...!! Praise be, praise be~~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"—Did our 'Little Comforts Search Squad' 
activity help you unwind a bit?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, you've improved a lot! It's just...
Yeah, you've improved so much! Just...

text_block_list.text: If there's one thing that concerns me—

Yo, little ladies! I came to buy in on 
that "romance" of yours!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What, you didn't know? Listen up, 
alright? Whenever you're near these little 
ladiesâ

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: A "Miracle" will happen!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I heard about it today too, y'know? How 
Kris S and Universe pulled off telepathy, 
and how a family heirloom was found!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And so, I've come here to claim a 
"romantic" miracle of my own.
choice_data_list: So that's what that was all about!?

text_block_list.text:
It seemed the little commotions I 
witnessed everywhere I went were the very 
moments those "miracles" occurred.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it might just be a coincidence, 
but... I'm glad if I've been helpful to 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I honestly just think it's a coincidence, 
though... If it's real, I wish it would 
happen to me too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Like a "miracle" where you could get a 
good grade on tomorrow's math test even 
using a dice pencil~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm not asking for a perfect 100, but 
could a 'miracle' maybe get me an 80~?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
80 points? Hah, it should be perfect! It's 
a genuine "miracle." Dream of something 
with way more "romance"!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd say an 80 is plenty 'romantic', 
though~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you hit 100 points, that's beyond a 
"miracle"— it's pure "fantasy"~
choice_data_list:
Rather than relying on a “miracle,” maybe 
I should start studying for exams early.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whateverrr, it's fineee. As long as I 
don't fail, anyway...
choice_data_list: You can do it without relying on Miracle!
You can do it without relying on Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, I think I'll be going. 
Making money with romantic flair will have 
to wait for next time—see ya!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, running away is cheating, Tap-chan~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Um, if there's anything I can do, 
just let me know. I'll help out with all 
I've got.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Trainer-san, there you go saying 
things like that again~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—No, Mirako's Trainer, I'm gettin' on your 
ship!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
As long as you dream, the odds aren't 
zero. Overturning the impossible is what 
true "romance" is all about...! âJust 
you wait, whatever-it's-called buried 
treasure!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, this is getting kinda weird... It 
really feels like we're going on a 
treasure hunt...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Next time, the 'Little Comforts 
Search Squad' might have to go on a field 
trip.
